name: redhelm
description: A live control panel for your Claude Code agents: activity traces, questions that wait for you, an agent sheet with Message and Stop, and a model guard.

placement.title: REDhelm placement
placement.description: Right: a sidebar beside the conversation (falls back to a panel above the prompt when the layout cannot dock). Bottom: the rack above the prompt.

statusLine.title: REDhelm line under the prompt
statusLine.description: Off: nothing from REDhelm there (its own status line, from the setup card, shows the model and effort). Problems: a notice only when the model switched on its own or the session fell behind your default. Always: the model and effort too.

guard.title: When the model changes without you
guard.description: Hold: your next prompt and Claude's tools wait until you choose with /model. Warn: say so, hold nothing. Off: do nothing.

notifyAfter.title: Desktop notification after turns longer than (seconds)

autoOpen.title: Open REDhelm by itself
autoOpen.description: When agents start or the project has a board, REDhelm, or REDManager. /redhelm always opens it.

agentToasts.title: Pop-ups when agents finish or message you
agentToasts.description: Short pop-ups in Claude Code when an agent finishes, fails, or sends you a message.

motion.title: REDhelm motion
motion.description: On: agents' activity traces move and a new question's edge flashes. Off: everything stays still between redraws.

labels.title: REDhelm labels
labels.description: Haiku: Claude Code's small model writes each working agent's headline and each question's short title (a few short requests while REDhelm is on screen). Plain: REDhelm's own words only.

workflowReading.title: REDhelm workflow reading
workflowReading.description: Sonnet: Save asks Claude Code's Sonnet (low effort) to read how the lead worked (one request each Save or Earlier; each Edit is one more). Off: Save shows only what REDhelm saw in the session, and Edit is not offered.

backdrop.title: REDhelm background
backdrop.description: What the sidebar draws behind your agents (terminal). Ripples: a grid of + signs; each tool call sends a ring through it in the agent's colour. Lattice: the grid alone, still. Field: drifting clouds of ASCII. Ember: a slow red glow. None: the pane's own colour.
